lines.trans: I did not know about your back.
After fifty films, we hurt everywhere!
You really made fifty films?
No, in reality, it is seventy films!
That is a very fine career, Gerard.
It is true, a story with lots of class.
And me, I have seventy coffees to serve.
Seventy-one coffees, my friend!
I have to go back to work at the bar.
Wait, I am going to sort everything out for you.
You want to speak to the director?
I am going to call Emma back immediately.
Thank you Gerard, you are a truly great person!
We are going to make this film together.

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.text: Après, elles ne peuvent plus s'arrêter.
On mange, et après on part.
examples.trans: We eat, and afterwards we leave.

meanings.note: on va arranger ça = we'll sort this out

meanings.en: au contraire = on the contrary; au revoir = goodbye

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

examples.text: Va chercher du champagne au bar.
examples.trans: Go and get some champagne at the bar.

examples.text: On prend un verre au bar?
examples.trans: Shall we have a drink at the bar?

meanings.note: before the noun; bel before a vowel: un bel endroit

examples.trans: You know a lot of people.

meanings.en: beaucoup de = a lot of, many

examples.text: C'est du sucre pour le café.

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.text: Elle a cinquante et un ans.

examples.trans: She has a lot of class.

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

examples.trans: I have to see the play.

meanings.note: avoir mal au dos = to have backache; final s is silent
preposition: en vacances, en huit ans
pronoun before the verb: j'en ai assez, je n'en peux plus

meanings.en: as a noun: the whole, a set

meanings.note: pour faire quoi? = to do what?
faire du vélo = to ride a bike, to cycle
raconter une histoire = to tell a story

examples.text: Je dois régler ce problème immédiatement.
examples.trans: I must settle this problem immediately.

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Je ne veux pas te faire de mal.
examples.trans: I don't want to hurt you.

meanings.note: faire du mal à quelqu'un = to hurt someone
merci beaucoup = thank you very much
ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never
tag at the end of a question
everyday speech, with a he/she verb form

examples.text: C'est impossible de travailler avec un bébé partout.
examples.trans: It's impossible to work with a baby everywhere.

meanings.en: pas du tout: not at all

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.

meanings.en: to call back, to phone again

examples.text: On peut retourner sur le plateau?
examples.trans: Can we go back to the set?

meanings.en: to go back, to return (conjugated with être)

meanings.note: la dure réalité = the harsh reality

examples.trans: Do you know where he is?

savoir.gloss: to know; to know how to

meanings.note: je ne sais pas = I don't know

examples.text: À quoi ça sert de payer une assistante?
examples.trans: What's the point of paying an assistant?

meanings.en: servir à = to be useful for, to be the point of
meanings.note: à quoi ça sert? = what's the point?
the x is pronounced like s: swasɑ̃t

examples.trans: I have seventy coffees to serve.

examples.text: Le livre est sur la table.
examples.trans: The book is on the table.

meanings.note: sur la table, sur la route
used alone, after a preposition, or for emphasis: et toi?, avec toi, toi aussi

examples.text: Le tournage commence dans trois semaines.

meanings.note: from tourner un film = to shoot a film

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

meanings.note: oui à tout = yes to everything
plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone
travailler à Paris, travailler le dimanche
+ noun: je veux un café; + infinitive: je veux partir
je vous rappelle = I'll call you back
place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
